bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 60
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 61
baseline="$(docker image inspect create-videobot:before-duplicate-guard-87ee908e --format '{{.Id}}')"
live="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')"
test "$baseline" = "$live" || exit 62
staged="$(docker image inspect create-videobot:duplicate-guard-87ee908e-stage --format '{{.Id}}')"
test "$staged" != "$live" || exit 63
current="$(docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll --format '{{.Id}}')"
test "$current" = "$live" || exit 64
echo DUPLICATE_GUARD_DEPLOY_BASELINE_SAFE=PASS
